$comment: Config for the editorconfig-checker hook in .pre-commit-config.yaml.
Scoping lives in .editorconfig itself wherever it can (see the
[tests/examples/**] sections there) so that the rules and their
exceptions stay in one place. Only what EditorConfig cannot express
$comment_Exclude: tools/generate_inspector_data.py: the same verbatim BigFix inspector
lines, trailing data-carrying tabs and all, relocated into src/ so the
library can read them at runtime. It lives outside tests/examples/, so
the .editorconfig exceptions there do not reach it. Same exclusion the
trailing-whitespace, typos and codespell hooks carry.
$comment_Disable: IndentSize checks that left-padding is a multiple of indent_size, which
flags ruff-format's own docstring prose continuations (e.g. the 2-space
bullet continuations in dialect.py). ruff-format already fully governs
Python indentation, so this check has nothing to add and 36 false
positives to contribute. indent_style, end_of_line, trailing whitespace
and final newline all stay on.
